text.en:
Suppressing an enemy grants +30 Mobility and 4% Forward Movement Speed Bonus. for 10 seconds and refreshes your readied weapon.
Buff duration serves as cooldown.

Upon <void/>Suppressing an enemy:
• <title Refills [G_refill] /> readied weapon from reserves
• Grants 30 mobility for 10 seconds
• Increases Forward Movement Speed by 4% for 10s

Cannot be reactivated while the buff is active.

Killing <void/>Suppressed enemies spawns a <void/>Void Breach.

Upon <void/>Suppressing an enemy:
• <title Refills [G_refill] /> readied weapon from reserves
• Grants 30 mobility for 10 seconds
• Increases Forward Movement Speed by 4% for 10s

10 second cooldown between activations.

Killing <void/>Suppressed enemies spawns a <void/>Void Breach.

Upon <void/>Suppressing an enemy:
• <title Refills [G_refill] /> readied weapon from reserves
• Grants 30 Weapons stat for 10 seconds
• Increases Forward Movement Speed by 4% for 10s

10 second cooldown between activations.

Killing <void/>Suppressed enemies spawns a <void/>Void Breach.
